{{Quote|Forbidden from speaking aloud by their Argazdan enslavers, the Lorrdians developed a sophisticated nonverbal language. Using this 'kinetic communication', the Lorrdians organized a rebellion that would eventually help end Argazdan rule. The implication for present day government is clear: harsh laws to end dissent will only ensure the downfall of their enforcers.|Janu Godalhi, in ''The Kanz Disorders: Lessons Learned''|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>}}
'''''The Kanz Disorders: Lessons Learned''''' was a thesis about the legal lessons that could be learned from the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]]. It was written by the historian [[Janu Godalhi/Legends|Janu Godalhi]] and published in the ''[[Coruscant Law Journal]]''. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] quoted it in an [[Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd, Or: What I Did On My Inter-Term Break|essay]] she wrote about a visit she made to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].
